devopsAgent.problem: Development teams spend countless hours on repetitive issue triage and resolution. Context switching between repositories and manual task coordination creates bottlenecks that slow down shipping.
devopsAgent.solution: A multi-agent system that automatically triages issues, researches context across repositories, and orchestrates parallel task execution. Agents collaborate to resolve issues while keeping humans informed at key decision points.
outcomes: ~50% reduction in issue triage time
Parallel execution across multiple repositories with session resume
Auto-fix CI failures and PR feedback iteration

complianceClassifier.problem: Classifying a business into the right industry code takes 10–30 minutes of manual research per entity — searching government registries, cross-referencing web presence, and interpreting ambiguous business activities. At scale, this becomes a bottleneck for merchant onboarding and KYB compliance workflows. Different jurisdictions use different classification systems (ANZSIC, SIC, NACE), and each client may enforce its own risk policy with distinct prohibited categories and thresholds.
complianceClassifier.solution: An AI-powered classification service that combines three intelligence sources: official government registries (ABR, NZBN, AUSTRAC), live web search for business activity research, and LLM reasoning for code assignment. Input data is first enriched from registries, then the AI analyzes web presence to determine business activities and map them to industry codes — validated against the official taxonomy hierarchy. A 4-tier risk engine evaluates the result: blacklist screening, code-to-risk mapping, keyword scanning with LLM disambiguation, and full LLM risk reasoning for ambiguous cases. Both the classification system and the risk policy are configurable per client.
outcomes: Classification accuracy above 90% with official registry cross-validation
Processing time under 1 minute per entity (vs. 10–30 minutes manual)
Configurable risk policies and classification systems per client
4-tier risk engine with hard-floor codes that cannot be overridden
Deployed in production for enterprise financial services clients

dataSourceAutomator.problem: Data engineering teams waste weeks researching data sources, writing specifications, building extraction pipelines, and deploying them. Each service needs a schema contract with the frontend, infrastructure provisioning, and end-to-end verification — a manual process that doesn't scale beyond a handful of services.
dataSourceAutomator.solution: A multi-agent pipeline that automates the entire lifecycle: research agents explore extraction methods, spec agents generate data models, coding agents build microservices with JSON schema contracts (search, detail, report, settings, config) that bridge backend and frontend, deployment agents push to Kubernetes via ArgoCD, and verification agents run automated checks across infrastructure, data contracts, and API responses. When tests fail, a code-fixer agent patches the code and redeploys automatically — with a LoopGuard that escalates to humans after 3 failed attempts on the same bug.
outcomes: 50+ microservices deployed through the pipeline
Automated deploy → verify → fix → redeploy feedback loop
JSON schema contract system bridging backend APIs and low-code frontend
Self-healing with LoopGuard: max 3 iterations per bug, then HITL escalation

mcpBitbucket.problem: Developers context-switch constantly between their IDE and Bitbucket's web interface. Repository management, PR reviews, and pipeline monitoring require manual navigation that breaks flow.
mcpBitbucket.solution: A Model Context Protocol server that exposes Bitbucket's full API to LLMs. Manage repositories, create and review pull requests, trigger pipelines, and monitor builds—all through natural language.
outcomes: 58 tools covering full Bitbucket API
TypeScript + Python implementations published on npm/PyPI
Open source with active maintenance

mcpPostgres.problem: Querying databases requires switching contexts, remembering schema details, and writing SQL. Non-technical stakeholders can't access data without engineering support.
mcpPostgres.solution: An MCP server that connects LLMs directly to PostgreSQL databases. Query, analyze, and interact with your data using natural language while maintaining security through read-only defaults.
outcomes: 14 tools for complete database operations
Security-first with read-only mode by default
Published on npm and PyPI

mcpLangfuse.problem: Debugging LLM applications requires constantly switching between code and the Langfuse dashboard. Accessing traces, scores, and datasets programmatically is cumbersome.
mcpLangfuse.solution: A comprehensive MCP server for Langfuse observability. Access traces, manage datasets, query scores, and handle prompt versioning—all through your LLM interface.
outcomes: 22 tools for complete observability access
Traces, scores, datasets, and sessions management
Works with Langfuse Cloud and self-hosted

steelPricing.problem: Steel buyers manage pricing across multiple suppliers, each with hundreds of tariff tables that change frequently. Calculating prices requires cross-referencing material specs, supplier agreements, and current rates — a manual process prone to errors and delays.
steelPricing.solution: A full pricing management platform with three AI integration points: a conversational assistant that fills calculation forms from natural language and queries pricing data, an email parser that interprets supplier price change notifications and suggests table updates (with human approval), and OCR-based PDF digitization that extracts tariff data from supplier documents for import.
outcomes: 925+ active pricing tables across 7 major steel suppliers
Three distinct AI integrations: assistant, email parsing, PDF digitization
Role-based access for purchasing, management, verification, and plant teams
All AI-suggested changes require human approval before applying

purchasingPlatform.problem: Managing Bills of Materials for steel infrastructure projects involves tracking thousands of line items across multiple suppliers, revisions, and procurement stages. Coordinating emails, categorizing materials, and summarizing plans is time-intensive manual work.
purchasingPlatform.solution: A purchasing management platform built for a steel corporation's Asia operations. AI is woven throughout: an assistant that answers questions about plans and data, automatic plan summarization, email generation for supplier communications, and intelligent material categorization when items aren't in the master database.
outcomes: 2,800+ BOM items processed across 11 active projects
AI-powered material categorization for unknown items
Automated plan summaries and supplier email generation
Trilingual support (English, Spanish, Chinese)

complianceAssistant.problem: Financial crime analysts spend hours manually reviewing verification reports, cross-referencing sanctions lists, PEP databases, and ownership structures across multiple screens. The review process is slow, error-prone, and doesn't scale.
complianceAssistant.solution: An AI assistant embedded directly in the compliance platform via iframe. Analysts query cases in natural language, get structured summaries of risk findings, UBO hierarchies, and screening results. The assistant can create and modify cases — but only after explicit human confirmation. PII is automatically redacted before storage, and all interactions are audit-logged.
outcomes: Structured LLM output via Zod schemas — summaries, tables, action cards, not free text
Human-in-the-loop for all write operations — the AI proposes, the analyst confirms
Semantic case search with pgvector + fuzzy fallback with pg_trgm
PII detection and redaction before database storage
Shipped to MSP (Minimum Sellable Product) stage

devopsSlackBot.problem: 70% of DevOps support requests are routine diagnostics — checking pod status, reading logs, verifying pipelines — that consume engineering time without requiring engineering judgment.
devopsSlackBot.solution: A Slack-based AI agent that autonomously investigates infrastructure issues using kubectl, Azure CLI, Bitbucket, Jira, and Confluence. Read-only by design, with infrastructure knowledge baked into the system prompt so it knows your clusters, naming conventions, and GitOps workflows.
outcomes: 70% of routine requests answerable without human intervention
6 tools with strict read-only guardrails and security validation
79% token reduction via intelligent output compaction
Progressive trust roadmap: read-only → safe actions → approval workflows → full autonomy

applicationAutomator.problem: Job seekers spend hours tailoring CVs and cover letters for each application. The repetitive process of adapting materials to job descriptions is time-consuming and mentally draining.
applicationAutomator.solution: An automation pipeline that analyzes job descriptions, adapts CV content to highlight relevant experience, and generates tailored cover letters. Human review ensures quality before submission.
outcomes: Automated CV tailoring per job description
Intelligent cover letter generation
Streamlined application workflow

medicalDocParser.problem: Medical professionals spend significant time manually extracting diagnoses from documents and coding them to ICD-10 standards. This process is error-prone and delays clinical workflows.
medicalDocParser.solution: An NLP-powered parser that extracts diagnoses from medical documents and automatically maps them to ICD-10 codes. Supports multiple document formats and integrates with clinical systems.
outcomes: >95% OCR accuracy, >90% correct ICD-10 mapping
Multilingual support: Spanish, Catalan, Galician
Processing under 2 min/doc, deployed for Tirea
